page.overview:
Who is Mayam Colona?

Mayam Colona is a Tairen Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has no Warder.

Mayam is slim, 5'6 tall, with dark skin, black eyes and black hair. She still lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She could eat as much as she liked without gaining a pound.

Mayam has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
